lines.text: I have no clue what to cook.

data.define: Used when you don't know something at all.

example.text: I have no clue what to cook.

misuse.text: Don't say 'no clue' in a job interview.

publish.title: What does "no clue" mean?
publish.value: No clue = I have no idea. Example: "I have no clue what to cook." (casual English).
